name: Aurora Jellyfish Ice Field
description: A frozen lake under swirling auroras where translucent jellyfish float above the ice, glowing softly.
prompt: A single ethereal scene of a frozen arctic lake beneath swirling green and violet auroras. Translucent jellyfish float just above the ice, glowing softly and trailing ribbons of light. Snow-covered rocks and distant ice mountains frame the view. Cold blue palette with warm bioluminescent accents, dreamy long-exposure feel, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Jellyfish in the Arctic sky? Sometimes the aurora learns new shapes. Would you ice-skate here?
